entry.name: MAV_AUTOPILOT_GENERIC
entry.description: Generic autopilot, full support for everything.

entry.name: MAV_AUTOPILOT_INVALID
entry.description: No valid autopilot (e.g. a GCS or MAVLink component).

enum.name: MAV_MODE_FLAG
enum.description: These flags encode the MAV mode.

entry.name: MAV_MODE_FLAG_GUIDED_ENABLED
entry.description: 0b00000100 guided mode enabled, system flies waypoints / mission items.

entry.name: MAV_MODE_FLAG_CUSTOM_MODE_ENABLED
entry.description: 0b00000001 system has a custom mode active.

entry.name: MAV_STATE_STANDBY
entry.description: System is grounded and on standby.

entry.name: MAV_STATE_ACTIVE
entry.description: System is active and might be already airborne.

entry.name: MAV_STATE_CRITICAL
entry.description: System is in a non-normal flight mode.

entry.name: MAV_STATE_EMERGENCY
entry.description: System is in a non-normal flight mode – it lost control over parts or over the whole airframe.

entry.name: MAV_FRAME_LOCAL_NED
entry.description: NED local tangent frame (x: north, y: east, z: down).

entry.name: MAV_FRAME_LOCAL_OFFSET_NED
entry.description: NED local tangent frame, offset from vehicle position.

entry.name: MAV_FRAME_BODY_NED
entry.description: Same as MAV_FRAME_LOCAL_NED rotated 90 degrees clockwise around z-axis.

enum.name: POSITION_TARGET_TYPEMASK
enum.description: Bitmask to indicate which dimensions should be ignored by the vehicle.

enum.name: ATTITUDE_TARGET_TYPEMASK
enum.description: Bitmask to indicate which dimensions should be ignored by the vehicle.

entry.name: ATTITUDE_TARGET_TYPEMASK_THRUST_BODY_SET
entry.description: Use 3D body thrust setpoint instead of throttle.

entry.name: MAV_ESTIMATOR_TYPE_NAIVE
entry.description: This is a naive estimator without any real covariance feedback.

entry.name: MAV_ESTIMATOR_TYPE_GPS_INS

message.name: HEARTBEAT
message.description: The heartbeat message shows that a system or component is present and responding. Emitted by the simulator at 1 Hz to allow the client to detect connection loss.
message.field: A bitfield for use for autopilot-specific flags.
Vehicle or component type. For the simulator this will be MAV_TYPE_QUADROTOR or MAV_TYPE_GENERIC.
Autopilot type / class. Use MAV_AUTOPILOT_GENERIC for the simulator.
MAVLink version, not writable by user, gets added by protocol because of magic data type: uint8_t_mavlink_version. Always 3 for v2.

message.name: ATTITUDE
message.description: The attitude in the aeronautical frame (right-hand, Z-down / x-front, y-right). Sent by the simulator to convey current vehicle orientation and angular rates.

message.name: SET_ATTITUDE_TARGET
message.description: Sets a desired vehicle attitude. Used by the contestant control software to command the simulator. The type_mask field selects which sub-fields are active.
message.field: Timestamp (time since system boot). Receivers should ignore messages with an incorrect timestamp.
System ID of the target vehicle (simulator's system ID).
Component ID of the target (e.g. autopilot component).
Bitmap to indicate which fields should be ignored.
Attitude quaternion (w, x, y, z order, zero-rotation is {1, 0, 0, 0}).
Collective thrust, normalised [0, 1] (-1..1 for vehicles capable of reverse thrust).

message.name: SET_POSITION_TARGET_LOCAL_NED
message.description: Sets a desired vehicle position in a local north-east-down coordinate frame. Used by the contestant control software to send position / velocity / acceleration setpoints to the simulator. Use type_mask to ignore sub-fields.
message.field: System ID of the target vehicle.
Valid options are: MAV_FRAME_LOCAL_NED, MAV_FRAME_LOCAL_OFFSET_NED, MAV_FRAME_BODY_NED, MAV_FRAME_BODY_OFFSET_NED.
Bitmap to indicate which dimensions should be ignored.
X position in NED frame (positive north).
Y position in NED frame (positive east).
Z position in NED frame (positive down). Use negative values for altitude above ground.
X acceleration or force (if bit 10 of type_mask is set) in NED frame.
Y acceleration or force in NED frame.
Z acceleration or force in NED frame.

message.name: HIGHRES_IMU
message.description: The IMU readings in SI units in NED body frame. Sent by the simulator to convey current vehicle sensor state.
message.field: Timestamp (UNIX Epoch time or time since system boot). Microseconds.

Bitmap for fields that have updated since last message; bit 0 = xacc, bit 1 = yacc, bit 2 = zacc, bit 3 = xgyro, bit 4 = ygyro, bit 5 = zgyro, bit 6 = xmag, bit 7 = ymag, bit 8 = zmag, bit 9 = abs_pressure, bit 10 = diff_pressure, bit 11 = pressure_alt, bit 12 = temperature.
Id. Ids are numbered from 0 and map to IMUs numbered from 1 (e.g. IMU1 is id=0).

message.name: TIMESYNC
message.description: Time synchronisation message. The simulator sends this with tc1=0 to initiate a sync request. The client echoes it back with tc1 set to the current timestamp, allowing the simulator to compute clock offset. Both sides repeat the exchange periodically (recommended: every 5 s).
message.field: Time sync timestamp 1. Set to 0 on the initiating (request) message; set to the local timestamp in nanoseconds on the response.
Time sync timestamp 2. Set to local timestamp in nanoseconds when the message is sent.

message.name: ODOMETRY
message.description: Odometry message encoding the position and velocity in a given reference frame. Sent by the simulator to provide ground-truth or estimated state for the vehicle.
message.field: Timestamp (UNIX Epoch time or time since system boot). Microseconds.
Coordinate frame of reference for the pose data.
Coordinate frame of reference for the velocity data.
Quaternion components (w, x, y, z order) representing vehicle orientation in the reference frame.
Row-major representation of a 6×6 pose cross-covariance matrix upper right triangle (states: x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw). Set to NaN if unknown.
Row-major representation of a 6×6 velocity cross-covariance matrix upper right triangle (states: vx, vy, vz, rollspeed, pitchspeed, yawspeed). Set to NaN if unknown.
Estimate reset counter. Increases each time the estimate resets in any of the dimensions (position, velocity, attitude). Zero by default. 0-255, rolls over.
Type of estimator that is providing the odometry.
